Direct Mail Services in Ulster County

Serving 36 communities across Ulster County from our New Paltz headquarters

Direct Mail Services Across Ulster County

Cornerstone Services, Inc. (CRST) provides full-service direct mail services in Ulster County, NY from its headquarters in New Paltz. Established in 1998, CRST handles in-house design, printing, data, EDDM, mail preparation, and fulfillment with no outsourcing for businesses, nonprofits, political organizations, municipalities, and real estate professionals throughout Ulster County.

Major Ulster County Service Areas

Direct Mail in New Paltz

Pop. 14,200 • ZIP: 12561

New Paltz is home to Cornerstone Services and SUNY New Paltz, one of the top public universities in the Northeast. Located at the foot of the Shawangunk Ridge, this vibrant college town supports a thriving mix of local restaurants, retail shops, outdoor recreation businesses, and cultural organizations. As your neighbors, we understand the New Paltz market inside and out — from student-focused promotions to year-round resident outreach.

Key Organizations
SUNY New PaltzMohonk PreserveNew Paltz Regional Chamber of CommerceHuguenot Historical Society
View New Paltz Services →

Direct Mail in Kingston

Pop. 23,900 • ZIP: 12401, 12402

Kingston is the county seat of Ulster County and New York State's first capital. With a revitalized Uptown Stockade District and booming Midtown arts scene, Kingston has become one of the Hudson Valley's most dynamic markets. From the Rondout waterfront to Broadway, local businesses and organizations rely on direct mail to reach Kingston's diverse residential neighborhoods and growing population of new residents.

City of KingstonUlster County GovernmentKingston City School DistrictBenedictine Health Foundation
